set.body: Found reviewing S3.4/S3.6 (branch worktree-agent-a976a82ff52af886d @ d9447c1). AppModel.update(Intent.Execution(ExecutionEvent.Changed(job))) updates the JobBoard but never dispatches Command.RecordRunOutcome, so the document's run stays RunLifecycle.Running after the job succeeds/fails/is cancelled. StudioDriver.feed papers over this with StudioDriver.outcomeOf (driver/StudioDriver.scala), which means every shell (JavaFX S1.4, TestFX E2E-01-ui) must re-implement the same rule or diverge from the headless route. Move outcomeOf into AppModel.update (terminal JobPhase -> RecordRunOutcome while the document still has the run Running; CoreBinding from the backend once S3.7 lands, not CoreBinding.unbound), delete the driver's copy, and add an AppModel-level test mirroring StudioDriverSuite 'a job's end is recorded as the run's outcome only while the run is running'. Acceptance: GoldenJourneyHeadlessSuite passes with StudioDriver.feed reduced to dispatching Intent.Execution.
set.title: AppModel: record a settled job's run outcome (RecordRunOutcome) in update, not in the shell
